people.name: Ahasuerus
people.line: Persian Emperor (probably Xerxes I); husband of Esther

translations.web: King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land, and on the islands of the sea.
translations.bsb: Now King Xerxes imposed tribute throughout the land, even to its farthest shores.
translations.kjv: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and upon the isles of the sea.
translations.asv: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and upon the isles of the sea.
